tone.target: wah-driven fuzz rock with thick, raw midrange
tone.profile: wah-driven fuzz rock with thick, raw midrange
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain featuring a Fuzz drive for grit, followed by a Wah pedal for lead work, feeding into a Marshall/Plexi style amp model (UK 45) with a robust 4x12 cabinet.
corrections: swap clean lead/reverb/delay for raw fuzz lead

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from high-gain fuzz circuits.
Provide the required fuzzy grit and raw breakup characteristic of 70s rock.
Implement the central wah element for lead riffs and solos.
Sustain and push the signal into the amp for maximum raw power.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD 9/Green OD to maintain a raw, non-bluesy tone structure.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Plexi/Marshall-style power amp required for classic 70s rock bite.
Provide the classic, punchy sound of a British 4x12 cabinet.
Sculpt the tone by emphasizing the raw midrange bite and cutting excessive low end.
Add minimal natural room ambience without losing the raw punch of the 70s rock sound.
blocks.gap: The genre demands a dry, aggressive tone; this reverb is kept very subtle to avoid sounding 'spacey'.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to capture the specific punch and grit of classic 70s rock, enhancing the raw midrange bite.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and grit needed for classic 70s rock bite.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased raw power and midrange focus
